Description: SPI serial shift clock generated by master
Master Out Slave In: serial transmission stream from SoC
Master In Slave Out: serial response driven by VIP device
Chip Select: asserted low during active SPI frame transaction
Parallel transmit byte loaded into shift register
Parallel received byte captured after 8 SCK cycles
High during active serial bit shifting
Clock Polarity: 0 = SCK low idle 1 = SCK high idle
Clock Phase: 0 = Sample leading edge 1 = Sample trailing edge
